facts.fact: CNDP president Omar Seghrouchni, interviewed 2026-08-04, speaks of Law 09-08 as in force for more than fifteen years and its paradigms as still applicable.

The CNDP president states that a proposed recasting of Law 09-08, worked up with the Justice Ministry, has been sent by that ministry to the Secrétariat général du gouvernement; no date of transmission is given, so the interview date is used.
A recast of Law 09-08 has entered the legislative circuit at the Secrétariat général du gouvernement, per the CNDP president on 2026-08-04.
Omar Seghrouchni speaks as president of the CNDP, which he says began fifteen years ago with a pedagogic approach and now strengthens its alert system 'pouvant aller jusqu'à des sanctions'.
The CNDP president describes the Data-Tika programme with public and private controllers, prior notifications to the CNDP and a possible sanctions step; he gives no sanction, decision or count.
